nodes.title: 狸猫·全域参考提示词模板
widgets_values:
subject_definitions:
<Subject 1> is the young woman in <Picture 1>, reproduced with every visible detail of the photo: waist-length straight black hair with a natural center part and fine face-framing strands; large dark-brown eyes with a bright, gentle gaze; softly arched brows; fair, smooth porcelain skin; a small nose and a soft closed-lip smile; a black fitted sports tank top; white distressed denim shorts with frayed hems; long slender fingers with neat manicured nails; slim waist and natural proportions. Her face keeps the photo's true bone structure and proportions, rendered as a real young woman on film.

<Subject 2> is the soft-lit studio shown in <Picture 1>: a seamless light-grey backdrop with a gentle top-left key light and a subtle floor shadow beneath her feet.

summary:
[reference generation] A single short continuous medium shot in <Subject 2>. <Subject 1> faces the camera, smiles warmly, lifts her right hand to shoulder height and waves at the camera in a slow, friendly arc — palm open, five fingers clearly separated and anatomically correct — then lowers her hand back to her side. Her body stays relaxed and stable; the camera holds a locked medium shot.

retention_analysis:
<Subject 1> (appears throughout [Shot 1]): fully_preserved - the black tank top, white denim shorts, hairstyle and facial identity carry over from <Picture 1> through every beat.
<Subject 2> (appears throughout [Shot 1]): fully_preserved - the light-grey studio backdrop and lighting remain constant behind every beat.

detailed_description:
A hyper-realistic live-action clip rendered with natural film grain and true-to-life skin texture. The camera is locked at eye level, framing <Subject 1> from the waist up. She breathes naturally, her smile soft and steady, the waving motion smooth with correct wrist articulation. Her hands are strictly five-fingered and anatomically correct in every frame; fingers never merge, twist or blur. The backdrop stays clean and the lighting stays consistent. There is no on-screen text, no subtitles and no watermark anywhere in the frame.

global_rules:
- Second pass may change ONLY resolution / steps / scheduler / denoise (0.2-0.3). Seed, prompt and reference order stay locked.
- Hands and fingers must remain stable and anatomically correct across all frames; no on-screen text.

## 狸猫·全域参考锻造 v2.4.0（2K交付版）

**默认激活 = 标准双采档**（已验证参数契约：8步草稿 → bf16 潜空间放大 ×1.5 → 精修 5 步）。

### 武戏档（右键 EIS 节点取消 Bypass）
双阶段 sigma 重采样：4 步·start 0.65→end 0.28·sine 分布，
社区双验证的高动作伪影解法；启用后二采自动获得中间步插值。

### 2K 高清档
1. 四件套已随镜像内置：2K-IC(Kijai rank21) + HyperFlow 8步 + LMS Sharp + Pika Ref2VA
2. 按 HyperFlow → LMS Sharp → IC 顺序取消三个 2K 档节点 Bypass
3. 放大倍率 1.5 → 2.2（约 2560×1440），双采计划 refine_steps 5 → 3
4. 种子/提示词/参考顺序锁死（二采铁律）
⚠️ 注意：IC 路线官方要求未剪枝 ref2va 基模；若与混合基模不兼容
（采样报错或花屏），改用「regen2k 后处理」路线（见运维档案）。

### 极速档
Pika H3 Flex 适配：启用前 bypass 三个 Turbo/Eros 适配节点，
双时钟 steps 8→6、CFG 1、7 值 sigma 手动表；禁止与 speed_slider 同开。

### 铁律
上采样器只准 bf16 文件；哨兵①拦截指纹异常（光斑事故的直接防线）。

## 9图 + 3视频 + 3音频 分工

图1 主角锚定 · 图2 正脸 · 图3 侧脸 · 图4 全身比例 · 图5 服饰细节
